subject.title: Write tool lacks append mode — isolated cron sessions destroy shared files

question: Should OpenClaw accept `append?: boolean` on the existing write tool as the permanent append contract, or require a different append API before closing this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the remaining fix is a model-facing and extension-observable tool contract rather than a purely internal patch.

options.title: Accept append flag on write
options.body: Land the open implementation after maintainer review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

options.title: Choose a different append contract
options.body: Ask for a replacement shape such as `mode: "append"` or a dedicated append tool before merging any public API.

options.title: Defer code and document workarounds
options.body: Keep the issue open and rely on backup or `exec >>` workarounds, accepting that data-loss risk remains for ordinary write calls.

recommendation.title: Accept append flag on write
recommendation.body: Land the open implementation after maintainer review, keeping overwrite as the default and using `append: true` for safe accumulation.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared write tool contract traces to this area history and the decision is about the model-facing agent runtime API.
